Name: Revised Valley
Author: TaelFayre
Description:
[b][size=5]﻿Description[/size][/b]
[size=3] Stardew Valley is a fantastic place, however, I had so minor issues with the vanilla map, So I got to work and modified things that I found convenient, as well as adding more detail to areas that didn't get enough love in my opinion.[/size]
[size=2]
 On a new save the map works as intended, however on saved game the map will have bushes in weird places, this happens due to the game generating bushes after the map is loaded, and not with it, thus when you change maps those bushes stay were they generated, There is no known fix for this other than getting [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]Destroyable Bushes [Click here].[/url] and then removing the bushes and saving the game

[/size][b][u][color=#b6d7a8]Images here do not show trees and bushes since they're generated when you start the game [/color]
[/u][/b]
[b][size=5]Changes[/size][/b][list]
[*]Includes The entirety of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Revised Town[/url].
[*]Changes Bus Stop
[*]Changes The Mountain Area
[*]Changes The Forest
[*]Changes The Path to Mountain
[/list][b][color=#ea9999]Known Issues[/color][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Bridge on top left of JoJa has collision [Unknown Fix][/size]
[/list]

[list]
[*][b][u][size=2][color=#e06666]Untested with anything that requires the vanilla areas [/color][color=#ffff00](they need patching)[/color][/size][/u][/b]

[/list][list]
[*][size=2]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5 on Linux/Mac/Windows.[/size]
[*][size=2]Works in Single-player and possibly Multiplayer[/size]
[*][size=2]Untested with Recolors, Probably compatible but with mismatching tiles in some places as I use my custom Diagonal Tiles, and they do not support recolors yet, and I don't plan to,  unless someone makes them for me :D[/size]
[*][size=2]Untested with mods that alter Events in changed areas[/size]
[/list]
